title: Short title
text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Penal Code, and hereinafter is referred to as “this Code”.

explanation.summary: Kifungu hiki kinaweka jina rasmi la sheria hii kuwa Penal Code. Hilo ndilo jina linalotumika kuitaja sheria hii.
points: Sheria hii inaweza kutajwa kwa jina la “Penal Code”.
Kifungu hiki kinahusu jina la sheria; hakiweki kosa au adhabu.

terms.meaning: Jina fupi rasmi linalotumika kuitaja sheria.
